chapterUpserts.summary: Ruth was born in 1936 in a farmhouse outside Bellwood, Ohio, where her mother kept bees. She walked two miles each way to a one-room school, and decided at nine years old that she would be a teacher.
openQuestions: Who was the teacher she wanted to be like?

anecdoteAdds.text: She walked two miles each way to a one-room school, and told her mother at nine years old that she was going to be a teacher. Nobody in the family recalls her ever considering anything else.
